data.gender_notes: Tanuja is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tanuja is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Tanu', which means delight or joy. This name is often associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who embodies knowledge, wisdom, and creativity. Tanuja is said to bring pleasure and happiness to those who bear the name, as well as to those around them. The name Tanuja carries the meaning “Delight, Joy, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Tanuja usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
